**What should it do**
One or two sentences.

**Why**
The case you are trying to cover. If it comes from real fabrication work, say so — that is the most useful kind of input.

**For a new infill pattern**
A sketch or photo, and how it should behave when the bay gets wider, narrower or steeper.

**For a new profile**
Designation, dimensions, and the source of the mass-per-metre figure.
